items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My wife just said to me this morning, before I came here – she said, “Dianne Reeves, I talked to her at the Hollywood Bowl.

ctx.x: Did you ever receive any voice lessons while you were coming up?

No, no. I never – even to this day I never studied. My wife just said to me this morning, before I came here – she said, “Dianne Reeves, I talked to her at the Hollywood Bowl. She has voice lessons every week, twice a week, and she practices every day.” She says, “You never practice and you never had any.”
